crop_policy.description: Canonical overhead plate interior crop with an elliptical mask; removes rig border and QR markers while retaining plate context.

hard_top1_dish_prior.description: Current PoC fusion: use Food-101 top-1 label, then keep only detector labels in the exact prior; raw proposals are retained only for debug.

no_fusion.description: Raw filtered YOLO-World proposals after confidence threshold, per-label NMS, and cap; no dish-prior gate.

weak_ground_truth_warning: Nutrition5k ingredient metadata is recipe-level metadata, not per-pixel visible-ingredient ground truth. Metrics below only score the five PoC detector labels when their names occur in metadata.
